dataset.truth: EPA AQS hourly 88101 (preferred) + 88502, POCs averaged per site-hour, UTC day from Date GMT/Time GMT, >= 18 valid hours; site-hours 2,049,361 (88101 1,883,959; 88502-only 165,402); per-site UTC offsets constant (6 h Central, 7 h Mountain standard time), spot-checked by hand
dataset.purpleair_pool: p2_processed_v3 daily raw-ATM means, all sensors in and out of Texas that UTC day; the 39,101 legacy 2025 rows that are not raw ATM (README 'Mixed PM2.5 basis') removed; median pool 232 sensors; no day had < 50
dataset.model_value: backend.main.run_predictions_batch on the production bundle at each monitor's coordinates; neighbor features from backend.purpleair.compute_neighbor_features; batch == per-day production call (max |diff| 0 over 8 random days)

protocol.fit: per UTC day, on that day's monitors only (what live serving can do)
protocol.P1: leave-one-site-out per day: the held-out monitor is excluded from the global fit AND the residual surface
protocol.P2: leave-region-out per day: every monitor within 50 km of the held-out one is excluded
protocol.scored_folds: folds with >= 10 fitting monitors (identical set for every method)
protocol.headline_population: Texas monitors (the map's domain); fits use all monitors in the bbox
protocol.tuning: hyperparameters chosen on 2023-2024 days by the mean of P1 and P2 MAE
protocol.bootstrap: day-block bootstrap (2,000 resamples) of the MAE difference

first_day_2023_01_01.note: UTC hours 00-05 of 2023-01-01 are local 2022-12-31 and sit in the 2022 annual AQS files, which were not downloaded; Central sites keep 18 of 24 h, Mountain sites (17 h) drop out. Training period only.

labels.SHIPPED: SHIPPED fixslope+kernel_v1: fixed slope 0.3 + intercept + residual kernel

timing.note: one core of the dev machine; a 0.1-CPU box is roughly 10x slower
